mapper.insert: insert into house_users (house_id, user_id, perms, is_admin) values (#{houseId}, #{userId}, #{perms}, #{isAdmin})
mapper.select: select hu.user_id, su.user_name, hu.perms, hu.is_admin, hu.join_time from house_users hu join sys_user su on su.user_id = hu.user_id where hu.house_id = #{houseId} order by hu.is_admin desc, hu.join_time asc
mapper.update: update house_users set perms = #{perms}, is_admin = #{isAdmin}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where house_id = #{houseId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from house_users where house_id = #{houseId} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from house_users where house_id = #{houseId} and is_admin = 1
